name: Tony Jashanmal
current_role: Group President, Jashanmal Group (Dubai); member of the Executive Board
profile: Kuwait-born (1947) scion of the Jashanmal family, whose Gulf trading/retail group dates back more than a century and distributes and retails books, fashion, accessories, home and electronics brands across the GCC. He joined in 1971 and led diversification into print media, accessories and fashion, post-Gulf War rebuilding in Kuwait and JV entry into India; he still sits on the Executive Board.
interesting_fact: He holds a Diplom-Volkswirt (Master's in Economics) from Hamburg University in Germany, after schooling in India and high school in Villars, Switzerland.
deep_cut_fact: He personally played a key role in rebuilding the group's Kuwait operations after the 1990-91 Gulf War, and has long championed e-commerce at the century-old retailer ('We have embraced technology wholeheartedly at Jashanmal').
notes: Hurun listing ended 2019. Day-to-day leadership: Group CEO is Shuja Jashanmal per the leadership page; Tony is Group President. Contact form is the retail customer form; no published press email found.

name: Xu Rongmao
current_role: Founder and controlling shareholder, Shimao Group Holdings (HKEX: 813); son Jason Hui Sai Tan has been chairman and president since 2024
profile: Xu Rongmao (Hui Wing Mau), born 1950 in Shishi, Fujian, built Shimao into one of China's big property developers, known for Shanghai riverside towers and hotels. He remains Shimao's controlling shareholder via Gemfair and Shiying Finance, but handed the chairmanship to his son in 2024 as the company worked through a debt restructuring.
interesting_fact: He earned a business master's degree by distance learning from the University of Adelaide.
deep_cut_fact: His first big project in his Fujian hometown started out registered as a knitting factory because private hotel investment was banned. When it was finished, the policy had changed, and he ended up owning what Wikipedia calls China's first private three-star hotel.
notes: He keeps a very low profile. Shimao is in a debt restructuring, and per Mingtiandi (July 2026) the CSRC proposed disclosure fines on him and his son. Any outreach would go through Shimao IR/media relations. The deep-cut fact rests only on Wikipedia, whose early-life details are partly tagged 'citation needed'.
